status: TODO(verify): draft from published instruments (PHQ-9 item 9, the C-SSRS screener, the Kemenkes list of suicide warning signs), waiting for the project owner's approval. Until the status is "verified", the AI features stay off.
note: Phrases are matched as whole words after lower-casing and removing punctuation (src/lib/ai/risk-check.ts). The list leans towards catching too much: a false match only opens the help screen instead of the AI. It is a guard in front of the AI, not a screening tool, and it has not been reviewed by a clinician.

id: Laptopku mati terus waktu mengerjakan skripsi.
Lampu kamar kos mati sejak kemarin.
Tugas ini menjadi beban yang berat minggu ini.
Aku ingin tidur lebih awal malam ini.
Aku bangun lagi jam lima untuk belajar.
Aku sudah minum obat flu yang diresepkan dokter.
Rasanya hidupku lebih baik setelah olahraga.
en: My laptop died during the exam.
I could kill for a coffee right now.
I want to sleep early tonight.
This assignment is a burden this week.
I woke up again at five to study.
I am dying to see my friends.
